intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个共同信号：AI 编程工具正从「能写代码」转向「管住代码质量与成本」。有人用提示词让 agent 少写废话，有人把代码库变成可查询的图来省 token，还有人干脆把多个 agent 并行调度起来。与此同时，纯 Rust 重写的桌面创作软件集体冒头，说明本地化、离线、可被 agent 驱动正在成为新的产品叙事。
intro.en: Today's batch points to one shift: AI coding tools are moving from writing code to controlling its cost and quality. Prompt skills trim agent output, codebase graphs cut token spend, and orchestrators run fleets of agents in parallel.

zh.summary: 一个 Claude Code 技能，把「最懒的资深工程师」人格注入 AI agent，让它少写代码、只写必要的一行。作者用 39 个真实任务做了对照测试，代码量、耗时和 token 都明显下降，测试覆盖率反而上升。
zh.insight: 切入点不是写更多代码，而是替团队做减法：给技术负责人做「agent 输出审计」，按 YAGNI 规则拦截过度设计，比通用代码审查更可量化。

en.summary: A Claude Code skill that injects the persona of the laziest senior dev in the room, pushing agents to write one line instead of fifty.
en.insight: The angle is subtraction, not generation: sell an agent-output audit to tech leads that flags over-engineering against YAGNI rules,

items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

zh.summary: 面向同时跑多个编码 agent 的开发者：每个 agent 在独立 git worktree 中并行工作，统一在一个界面里追踪，还提供手机端监控和跟进。用户可以用自己的订阅运行 Claude Code、Codex 等。
zh.insight: 机会在「多 agent 结果对比」这一层：把同一 prompt 分发给多个 agent 后，谁能自动 diff、评分并推荐合并哪个分支，谁就掌握了工作流入口。

en.summary: Built for developers running several coding agents at once: each works in its own git worktree, tracked from one place, with a mobile companion for monitoring and follow-ups.
en.insight: The opening is comparison, not orchestration: whoever auto-diffs, scores and recommends which agent branch to merge owns the workflow entry point once fan-out…

items.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

zh.summary: 把代码、文档、SQL schema、配置和 PDF 解析成可查询的知识图谱，作为 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的斜杠命令使用。基于本地确定性 AST 解析，每条边都有解释，不依赖向量库。
zh.insight: 适合做「大型遗留代码库的 agent 上下文层」：面向接手老系统的团队，用结构化图替代 grep 和向量检索，卖点是不确定性低、可审计。

en.summary: Turns code, docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph, exposed as a slash command inside Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools.
en.insight: Position it as the context layer for large legacy codebases: teams inheriting old systems get a structured graph instead of grep and embeddings,

items.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 让普通游戏 PC 跑起原本需要服务器的百亿级参数模型，提供 Windows 和 Linux 一键安装，在本机暴露 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容 API，可选图像输入。支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel。
zh.insight: 适合做「本地模型即插即用」的封装层：面向隐私敏感的中小团队和独立开发者，卖点是聊天和文件不出本机，且现有 agent 工具无需改代码即可接入。

en.summary: Runs a 125-billion-parameter model that normally needs a server on an ordinary gaming PC, with one-click installers for Windows and Linux and an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API on…
en.insight: Package it as plug-and-play local inference for privacy-sensitive small teams and solo developers: chats and files never leave the machine,

items.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on any consumer hardware: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 一个 Linux Wayland 桌面环境，主打 iOS 6 式的拟物化设计，界面元素都画得像真实物件。刚发布首个公开测试版，提供 Fedora 安装器，项目名和命令来自 Reddit 社区投票。
zh.insight: 这不是创业方向，更像设计趋势信号：拟物化回潮说明用户对扁平化审美疲劳，做桌面或移动端 UI 组件库的团队可以关注这类视觉语言的商业化空间。

en.summary: A Wayland desktop environment for Linux built around iOS 6-style skeuomorphism, where on-screen elements are drawn to look like real objects.
en.insight: Not a startup, but a design signal: the skeuomorphic revival suggests fatigue with flat UI, so teams shipping desktop or mobile component libraries should…

items.description: Wayland desktop for Linux with skeuomorphic design

zh.summary: 一个框架无关的生成式 UI 框架，围绕紧凑的流式语言设计，官方支持 React、Vue、Svelte 和 Angular。相比让模型直接输出 JSON，它声称 token 消耗最多减少 67%。
zh.insight: 适合做「agent 返回结构化界面」的中间层：面向做 AI 客服、报表助手的团队，用更省 token 的 DSL 换更低延迟，而不是每次都渲染通用聊天框。

en.summary: A framework-agnostic generative UI framework built around a compact streaming-first language, with first-party runtimes for React, Vue, Svelte and Angular.
en.insight: Sell it as the layer between agents and structured UI: teams building AI support or reporting assistants get lower latency from a lean DSL instead of dumping…

items.description: The Open Standard for Generative UI

zh.summary: 浏览器里的「间谍卫星模拟器」，但数据全部来自公开源：实时飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头，叠加在写实 3D 地球上，还支持语音控制。无需 API key 即可启动。
zh.insight: 适合做成 OSINT 与地理情报的展示与教学产品：面向记者、供应链分析和安全培训，把分散的公开数据源包装成可交互的场景，而不是再做一个地图 API。

en.summary: A spy-satellite simulator in the browser where every layer is public data: live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe,
en.insight: Build it into an OSINT and geospatial-intelligence demo or training product for journalists, supply-chain analysts and security teams,

items.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.

zh.summary: 用纯 Rust 从零重写的开源照片编辑器，支持图层、蒙版、调整图层、文字、矢量、笔刷和真实 PSD 文件，原生离线运行。属于 ArtCraft 系列，同一团队还发布了 PDF、视频和 RAW 工具。
zh.insight: 真正的差异点是 PSD 兼容加本地离线：面向被订阅制劝退的设计师和摄影工作室，可以先从「PSD 查看与轻编辑」这种低门槛场景切入。

en.summary: An open-source photo editor rebuilt from scratch in pure Rust, with layers, masks, adjustment layers, type, vectors, brushes and real PSD files, running natively offline.
en.insight: PSD compatibility plus local-only processing is the wedge: target designers and photo studios tired of subscriptions,

items.description: PhotoCraft: An open-source, photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust

zh.summary: 非破坏性照片库与 RAW 冲图工具，纯 Rust 编写，原生支持三大桌面系统，也能通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器运行。特别之处是端到端可由 AI agent 通过 MCP 驱动。
zh.insight: MCP 驱动是关键信号：可面向批量修图的电商和摄影团队，做「用自然语言下达冲图指令」的工作流，把重复调色变成可脚本化的任务。

en.summary: A non-destructive photo library and RAW developer written in pure Rust, native on macOS, Windows and Linux and also running in the browser via WebAssembly.
en.insight: MCP support is the signal: target e-commerce and photo teams doing bulk edits with natural-language develop instructions,

items.description: LightCraft: An open-source non-destructive photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust

zh.summary: 视频与图像修复工具，能自动定位画面中的马赛克区域并只对该区域做还原，其余画面不动。提供图形界面和命令行，在本机 GPU 上运行，部分模型需要付费许可证。
zh.insight: 垂直需求非常明确但合规风险高：更适合作为本地批处理工具卖给影视后期和档案修复场景，而不是面向大众的在线服务，许可证模式也值得借鉴。

en.summary: A video and image restoration tool that finds mosaic regions in a frame and restores only those areas, leaving the rest untouched.
en.insight: The niche is sharp but legally sensitive: better sold as an offline batch tool for post-production and archival restoration than as a consumer online service,
